mapper.select: SELECT SUMMARY_ID, MODEL_ID, PERIOD, VERSION, SUMMARY_TYPE, DIMENSION_CODE, DIMENSION_NAME, SUMMARY_VALUE, SUMMARY_METHOD, DATA_COUNT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME FROM TBL_BUDGET_SUMMARY WHERE MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND PERIOD = #{period} AND VERSION = #{version} AND SUMMARY_TYPE = #{summaryType} AND ORG_ID = #{orgId} ORDER BY DIMENSION_CODE ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as "totalCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "completedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "processingCount", SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "failedCount", SUM(DATA_COUNT) as "totalDataCount" FROM TBL_BUDGET_SUMMARY WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId}
